subject: Post-demo: security checklist & subprocessor deliverables
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Caleb Sanders <caleb.sanders@meddata.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@meddata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: security checklist & subprocessor deliverables

Hi Caleb / Priya —

Thanks again for your time on the demo earlier. Per our conversation, we want to make the security/compliance review as straightforward as possible. Below is a short recap and the items we need to progress the procurement/contract review: 

1) SOC 2 status: please confirm current Type (I/II), date of last audit, and whether report can be shared under NDA.
2) GDPR/HIPAA: confirm if you treat customer data as PHI for this use case and whether you'd require a BAAs.
3) Subprocessor list: please share an exportable list (name, purpose, country, data access type) for any cloud providers, analytics, or hosting partners.
4) Vendor security questionnaire: we can start with a short VSQ. If you prefer, send yours and we’ll fill it out.
5) Procurement contacts and expected timeline for legal review + PO or MOU.

Attachments & references: we typically exchange a subprocessor CSV and a one-page security summary — happy to accept yours.

Next steps I propose:
- Caleb: share subprocessor CSV + any applicable SOC 2 artifacts (or confirm timing).
- Priya: loop your procurement lead and share preferred VSQ style.
- Monica: I’ve copied our SE to coordinate on technical controls and scope.
- Grace: please flag any immediate blockers from compliance side.

If helpful, we can do a short follow-up call next week to walk through the subprocessor list.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: demo-deck-redwood.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Caleb Sanders <caleb.sanders@meddata.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@meddata.com>
Cc: MedData Solutions (Procurement)
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security checklist & subprocessor deliverables

Diego — thanks for the clear notes and the quick summary.

Short answers up front:
- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in Dec 2025. We can share the report under NDA; I’ve attached a redacted summary for now.
- GDPR/HIPAA: For the workflows we demoed, MedData classifies the data as PHI. We will require a BAA for any deployment that processes PHI.
- Subprocessors: attaching our current subprocessor list (CSV) — includes cloud infra, analytics, and monitoring partners.
- VSQ: I’m attaching our standard security questionnaire (PDF); please have your SE fill the technical sections.
- Procurement timeline: procurement is starting review; target to exchange an MOU the week of May 3.

Attachments: 1) meddata_subprocessors_20260419.csv (CSV) 2) meddata_vsq_answers_20260419.pdf (PDF) 3) redlined_mou_meddata_v1.docx (DOCX stub)

Question for you: can Redwood sign a standard BAA and do you support isolated customer deployments/VPC peering for PHI? Also, what is the retention default for conversational logs and can that be configured per-customer?

Thanks — Caleb
Caleb Sanders
Head of Integrations | MedData Solutions
caleb.sanders@meddata.com
[Attachment: meddata_subprocessors_20260419.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: meddata_vsq_answers_20260419.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Caleb Sanders <caleb.sanders@meddata.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@meddata.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security checklist & subprocessor deliverables

Caleb — appreciate the quick turnaround and the files. I started a technical pass on the VSQ and subprocessor CSV. Initial notes below and next steps: 

- BAA: Redwood supports signing a standard BAA; Grace, can you confirm the template or exceptions?
- Isolated deployments: we support VPC/private deployments and can scope an on-prem or customer-managed network for PHI workloads.
- Retention: default conversational logs are 90 days for hosted; we can configure retention to customer requirements on Dedicated or Private deployments — will include options in the MOU.

Action items / timeline: 
1) Monica (SE) — complete VSQ technical sections and return by Wed 2026-04-21.
2) Diego (AE) — coordinate commercial MOU language with procurement; target send first draft 2026-04-26.
3) Grace (Security) — confirm BAA template compatibility and any SOC 2 evidence gating items.

Also looping procurement contacts makes sense — Priya, can you share the procurement lead’s email? If you prefer, I can start filling our side of the DocuSign to speed signature.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Note: I redacted a couple of sensitive config details from the VSQ before sharing internally]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Caleb Sanders <caleb.sanders@meddata.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@meddata.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security checklist & subprocessor deliverables

Thanks everyone — quick compliance update from my side.

SOC 2: Confirming MedData’s note — they completed a Type II in Dec 2025. We will request the full SOC 2 report under NDA; summary is fine for initial review.

BAA / PHI: Redwood will execute a BAA for PHI workloads. For Hosted customers, we offer contractual controls and data processing addenda; for PHI we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment to minimize cross-tenant risk.

Subprocessor risk: I reviewed the CSV. Primary notes: 
- Core infra: list includes two major cloud providers (multi-region). Need confirmation of encryption-at-rest keys (customer-managed or Redwood-managed).
- Analytics/Monitoring: some third-party telemetry vendors have broad access; we should flag any that have log ingestion capabilities that include full request payloads.

Compliance checklist (owners & deadlines):
- Receive full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA — Owner: Diego — Due: 2026-04-23
- Confirm subprocessor encryption and key management model — Owner: Caleb + Diego — Due: 2026-04-23
- Complete VSQ technical sections (Redwood SE) — Owner: Monica — Due: 2026-04-21 (in progress)
- Procurement cadence: draft MOU with BAA options — Owner: Diego — Due: 2026-04-26

I can begin a focused review of the SOC 2 and subprocessor controls once we have the report and exported evidence for the two monitoring vendors. If MedData prefers, we can schedule a 30-min technical compliance call (Grace + Monica + MedData security) — I’m available Tue/Wed mornings next week.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redacted_soc2_summary_meddata_apr2026.pdf (application/pdf)]
